descripcion_geo: One of the five cities of the plain (pentapolis) destroyed along with Sodom and Gomorrah; Its exact location is uncertain.
importancia_estrategica: City of the valley of Siddim destroyed next to Sodom.

historias.titulo: Zeboim in the battle of the four kings against five
historias.descripcion: The king of Zeboim participated in the coalition of the five kings of the valley against the four kings of the east.

historias.titulo: God destroys Zeboim along with Sodom
historias.descripcion: Zeboim is destroyed along with Sodom, Gomorrah, Adma and Zoar by God's judgment.

historias.titulo: Hosea: Adma and Zeboim as a warning
historias.descripcion: Hosea cites the destruction of Adma and Zeboim as a warning to Israel: the same judgment could fall upon him.

personajes.descripcion: One of the five kings who first allied themselves against the east and were then defeated.
He rescued Lot who was captured in the battle of the four kings against the five that included Zeboim.
He cited the destruction of Zeboim as a paradigm of divine judgment to warn the Israel of the north.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Zeboim: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Sodom, Gomorrah, Adma and Zeboim are the biblical paradigm of total judgment; its destruction is cited by several prophets as a warning.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Sodom, Gomorrah, Adma and Zeboim are the biblical paradigm of total judgment; its destruction is cited by several prophets as a warning.
